target: बचा हुआ खाना फ़्रिज के अंदर रख दो।
english: Put the leftover food inside the fridge.
reason: UNNATURAL: 'आज के लिए खाना बहुत हो गया' is translationese; no native speaker phrases 'that's enough eating' this way. Replaced with an everyday compound-postposition (के अंदर) sentence.

target: मैं इस काम को शाम तक पूरा कर लूँगा।
english: I will finish this work by evening.
reason: PREACHY: 'I do all my work with full dedication' is a self-praising motto, not speech. Replaced with an ordinary को-marked object sentence.

target: स्टेशन से घर आने में आधा घंटा लगा।
english: It took half an hour to get home from the station.
reason: NICHE VOCAB: saw (आरी) and log (लट्ठा) are words a learner will never use. Same 'X में वक़्त/समय लगा' postposition pattern kept with everyday travel vocabulary.

target: दवा लेने से भी बुख़ार नहीं उतरा।
english: The fever did not come down even after taking the medicine.
reason: NICHE + FORMAL: prosthetic limbs and 'संभव हुआ' are clinical register a learner will not use. Same -ने से causal structure, plus everyday negation.

target: माँ के हाथ की बनी खीर सबसे अच्छी होती है।
english: Kheer made by mother is the best.
reason: UNGRAMMATICAL: 'माँ की हाथ की' is wrong (हाथ is masculine, needs के). Corrected while keeping the सबसे superlative.

target: बच्चों ने खाना बड़े मज़े से खाया।
english: The children ate the food with great relish.
reason: TEXTBOOK/UNUSABLE: 'The soldiers fought bravely' is a stock schoolbook line no learner will say. Same ने ergative past with a से adverbial phrase.

target: माँ रसोई में खाना बना रही है।
english: Mom is cooking food in the kitchen.
reason: NICHE VOCAB: weaver and warp-and-weft (ताना-बाना) are dead vocabulary for a learner. Same present continuous, everyday scene.

target: हमारे मोहल्ले में हर शनिवार को बाज़ार लगता है।
english: A market is held in our neighbourhood every Saturday.
reason: ENCYCLOPEDIC TRIVIA: a definition of a festival, reads like a quiz fact. Same में/को postposition practice with a usable everyday statement.

target: पंखा चलाने से कमरा जल्दी ठंडा हो जाता है।
english: The room cools down quickly when you turn the fan on.
reason: NICHE: whitewashing a wall with lime (चूना) is niche and dated vocabulary. Same -ने से cause structure with an everyday household fact.

target: इस बाज़ार में शाम को सबसे ज़्यादा भीड़ होती है।
english: This market is most crowded in the evening.
reason: TRIVIA + VAGUE: 'crores of people at this religious place' is encyclopedic and 'इस धार्मिक जगह' is oddly vague. Replaced with a natural सबसे ज़्यादा comparison.

target: पहले हम एक छोटे से मकान में रहते थे।
english: We used to live in a small house before.
reason: STORYBOOK/NICHE: a thatched-roof farmer's house reads like the opening of a school story. Same में locative with a sentence a learner would actually say.

target: चावल, दूध और चीनी मिलाकर खीर बना लो।
english: Mix rice, milk and sugar and make kheer.
reason: UNNATURAL: 'खीर में चावल, दूध और चीनी पकाओ' literally says cook them inside the kheer. Rewritten naturally with the compound verb बना लो.
UNNATURAL WORD ORDER: 'उसके बड़े पैर हैं' is calqued from English. Hindi puts the adjective in predicate position; agreement (बड़े/पैर) is still the teaching point.
